question: Why is the Lord the foundation of brahman, duty, and happiness?
premises: the Lord is foundation of immortal imperishable brahman
served in the Lord brahman becomes manifest
otherwise worshipped brahman remains inert and gives sleep-like liberation
inference: Brahman, duty, and absolute happiness have their foundation in the Lord, and service to the Lord makes brahman manifest.
uncertainties: fused sandhi forms are glossed as wholes
plain_english: I am the foundation of brahman, the immortal and imperishable, and of eternal duty and absolute happiness; when I am served, brahman becomes, otherwise worshipped brahman remains inert and would give liberation no different from deep sleep.
